rationale: The producer correctly fixed queue.py (atomic put, ack/nack get pattern) and priority.py (type-safe tie-breaker with seq counter). However, consumer.py was listed in writable_paths but was NOT updated — it still uses the old fire-and-forget pattern calling self._queue.get() and treating the result as a plain message instead of unpacking the (message, receipt) tuple and calling self._queue.ack(receipt). This will crash or lose messages under the new queue API.
repair_plan: Update TaskConsumer.run_once() to: 1) Unpack the (message, receipt) tuple from self._queue.get(), 2) Wrap self._handler(message) in try/except, 3) Call self._queue.ack(receipt) on success, 4) Call self._queue.nack(receipt) on exception to re-queue the message.
